cases.purpose: Repeated missing stat failures report the path, preserve descriptor identities, and recover in the same shell.

files.snap/meminfo:
MemTotal: 1024 kB
MemAvailable: 256 kB
SwapTotal: 512 kB
SwapFree: 128 kB
files.inner.sh:
name=$1
/usr/bin/mkdir -p "$HOME/realproc"
/usr/bin/mount -n --bind /proc "$HOME/realproc" || exit 91
/usr/bin/mount -n --bind "$PWD/snap" /proc || exit 92
shopt -s nullglob
fds=("$HOME/realproc/$BASHPID/fd/"*)
(( ${#fds[@]} >= 3 )) || exit 93
snapshot() {
  local f
  for f in "$HOME/realproc/$BASHPID/fd/"*; do
    [[ -L $f ]] || continue  # the glob's own directory descriptor is already closed
    printf '%s ' "${f##*/}"
    /usr/bin/readlink "$f" || return 1
  done
}
snapshot > "$HOME/snapshot" || exit 94
/usr/bin/cp "$HOME/snapshot" "$HOME/before" || exit 94
for i in 1 2; do
  top --once > "$HOME/out$i" 2> "$HOME/err$i"; status=$?
  [[ $status == 1 && ! -s $HOME/out$i ]] || exit 95
  /usr/bin/grep -F "/proc/$name:" "$HOME/err$i" >/dev/null || exit 96
  snapshot > "$HOME/snapshot" || exit 97
  /usr/bin/cp "$HOME/snapshot" "$HOME/after$i" || exit 97
  /usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/before" "$HOME/after$i" || exit 98
done
/usr/bin/mv "$PWD/snap/saved-$name" "$PWD/snap/$name" || exit 99
top --once > "$HOME/recovered" 2> "$HOME/recovered.err"; status=$?
[[ $status == 0 && -s $HOME/recovered && ! -s $HOME/recovered.err ]] || exit 100
snapshot > "$HOME/snapshot" || exit 101
/usr/bin/cp "$HOME/snapshot" "$HOME/after-recovery" || exit 101
/usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/before" "$HOME/after-recovery" || exit 102
printf 'failure-recovery-fds=PASS\n'

cases.oracle: Independent proc(5) encoded fixture: process PIDs 101/202/303, explicit stat field positions and RSS page counts, fixed load, mem, swap, uptime and CPU counters. Userns control verifies the overlay and x86_64 page size; /dev/full is an independently probed guest ENOSPC sink.
cases.comparison: Checks exact failure status and missing path, unchanged descriptor names and targets after each failure, and successful recovery in the same shell. Namespace setup failure is not coverage. Descriptor snapshots skip the entry for the listing glob's own directory descriptor, which is closed before it is read.

cases.purpose: Empty stat fails with a diagnostic and no descriptor leak, and recovers in the same shell.
cases.setup_script:
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c '
/usr/bin/mount -n --bind "$PWD/snap" /proc || exit 91
[[ $(< /proc/loadavg) == "0.25 0.50 1.00 1/3 303" ]] || exit 92
[[ $(/usr/bin/getconf PAGESIZE) == 4096 ]] || exit 93
' 
[[ -f snap/stat && ! -s snap/stat ]]
